entities.summary: Roman Petrovych Bezsmertnyi is a Ukrainian politician who served as a People's Deputy of Ukraine for four terms between 1994 and 2007. He also served as deputy head of the secretariat of the Ukrainian president and as ambassador of Ukraine to Belarus. Bezsmertnyi is also a former Deputy Prime Minister of Ukraine, responsible for administrative and territorial reform.
